envelope.thread: stable nonempty business ID, max 128 characters
envelope.issued: integer Unix milliseconds, at most 30 seconds in future
envelope.until: integer Unix milliseconds, strictly after issued, unexpired

AtelierBulletin.ttl: up to 7 days; read only on actual system-message selection

RunwayPresence.ttl: 5..300 seconds; blocked or old version ignored; expires to offline

media: asset, bundle/filename, or full HTTP(S) URL; max 12

CircleLookPublished.ttl: up to 7 days; never overrides likes/comments; existing post IDs ignored

detail.stage: received | applied | displayed | read | ignored | expired | failed

ack.name: AtelierReceiptAccepted
ack.rule: Only backend ack removes durable outbox entry; duplicate receipts must be acknowledged again; ack has no ack

replay.name: AtelierReplayRequest

pending: received but not applied thread IDs

replay.rule: attach/reconnect/foreground and at most periodic 60-second request; server preserves original IDs and expiry

limits.scope: API origin + Ably channel + local account
limits.retry: 2,4,8,16,32,60 seconds, foreground only; receipt ID unchanged

backendRequired: Authenticate senders; publish non-conflicting stable IDs; only acknowledge persisted receipts; replay unapplied events/latest unexpired presence. No real RTC, incoming calls, VoIP or person-to-person delivery is added by this integration.
